label: B — ChatGPT, structured spec (no skill)
description: A precision-augmentation system that transforms vague language into context-optimized, audience-specific descriptions. Core engine: detects ambiguity in input text, generates candidate replacements across a vague-to-precise spectrum, and ranks them along a formal specificity axis. Context calibration: conditions outputs on audience, domain lexicons, cross-language precision, and emotional register. Personalization layer: learns user stylistic preferences through comparative selection, quizzes, and writing analysis. Output interfaces: inline replacement, precision sliders, and multimodal generation (text, image, video, graphs). Applications: targeting, applications, founder/company search, and skill articulation. Evaluation loop: A/B testing, user inspection, and self-improving skill updates.
